draft_en.subject: PoE switches for your CCTV distribution - 8-PoE L2+ and 24-PoE, neutral brand
draft_en.body:
Hello Silmar team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 8 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches you distribute with CCTV lines, neutral-brand units from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS:

- 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed (web GUI, VLAN), Marvell-based, model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity)
- 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP uplinks, L2+ managed, model STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5 USD EXW

One question: which PoE SKU moves the most volume through your branches - 8, 16 or 24 ports?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
